shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.subtitle: We work hard to get your order to you as quickly and safely as possible.

time.title: Delivery Time
time.body: Orders are typically delivered within 2–4 business days from the time of confirmation. Remote governorates may take an additional 1–2 days.

cost.title: Shipping Cost
cost.body: Shipping fees are calculated based on your delivery area and are displayed at checkout before you place your order.

areas.title: Delivery Areas
areas.body: We currently deliver to all 27 Egyptian governorates. If your area is not available, please contact us and we'll do our best to help.

tracking.title: Order Tracking
tracking.body: Once your order is confirmed, you'll receive updates via WhatsApp. You can also track your order status from the My Orders section.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions about shopping at Tamara Land.
faq.contactSupport: Our customer support team is available 24/7 to assist you.

order.q: How do I place an order?
order.a: Browse our catalog, select your size and color, then add items to your cart. When you're ready, proceed to checkout, enter your delivery address and confirm your order.

shipping.a: Most orders are delivered within 2–4 business days. Delivery time may vary based on your location and courier availability.

sizes.q: How do I find the right size?
sizes.a: Each product page includes a detailed size guide with measurements in centimeters. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for comfort.

payment.a: We currently accept Cash on Delivery. Online payment options will be available soon.

cancel.a: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Please contact us as soon as possible via WhatsApp if you need to cancel.

track.q: How do I track my order?
track.a: You'll receive WhatsApp updates at each stage of your order. You can also view your order status in real time from the My Orders page.

gift.a: We currently do not offer gift wrapping, but all Tamara Land orders are packed with care and elegance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy.
privacy.notice: This policy was last updated in 2025 and applies to all users of the Tamara Land platform.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, and delivery address when you register or place an order.

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.body: Your information is used to process your orders, send delivery updates, and improve our services. We do not sell your data to third parties.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We implement industry-standard security measures including encrypted data storage and secure HTTPS connections to protect your personal information.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact our support team.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please reach out to our support team via email or WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Tamara Land platform.
terms.notice: By using our website and placing orders, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using the Tamara Land website or app, you accept and agree to be bound by these terms and our Privacy Policy.

orders.title: Orders & Availability
orders.body: All orders are subject to product availability. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order if a product is out of stock or if we suspect fraudulent activity.

pricing.title: Pricing & Payments
pricing.body: All prices are listed in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) and are inclusive of applicable taxes. Prices are subject to change without notice.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.body: All content on this website, including images, text, and branding, is the property of Tamara Land and may not be reproduced without written permission.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.body: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of our platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
